question_text: How many cumulative laboratory-confirmed Bundibugyo virus disease cases (DRC and Uganda combined) will be in WHO reporting as of October 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: The latest confirmed-case total in the WHO report covering on or nearest before October 31, 2026. Source: WHO Ebola (DRC 2026) situation reports and Disease Outbreak News.

question_text: How many cumulative reported deaths (confirmed plus probable) in the Bundibugyo outbreak will WHO report as of December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: The death total in the WHO report covering on or nearest before December 31, 2026. Source: WHO situation reports.

question_text: Will the Bundibugyo virus disease PHEIC still be in effect on December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: TRUE if the PHEIC has not been terminated by December 31, 2026. Source: WHO IHR Emergency Committee statements and the Director-General PHEIC determinations.

question_text: Will at least one laboratory-confirmed Bundibugyo case linked to this outbreak be reported in a country other than DRC or Uganda on or before December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: TRUE on the first confirmed exported or third-country case attributed to this outbreak, by December 31, 2026. Source: WHO Disease Outbreak News.

question_text: Which Bundibugyo-relevant medical countermeasure milestone will be reached first during the outbreak window by December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: The first option publicly documented by December 31, 2026, or both if both occur in the window. Source: WHO, ICTRP and other trial registries, partner announcements.

question_text: How many human H5 infections (any neuraminidase subtype) will be reported to WHO globally between July 1 and December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Count of newly reported human H5 cases with onset or report date inside the window, as of December 31, 2026. Source: WHO Influenza at the human-animal interface assessments and Disease Outbreak News.

question_text: Will WHO or a national public health authority confirm at least one cluster meeting its stated criteria for sustained human-to-human transmission of an H5 virus on or before December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: TRUE on a WHO or national-authority statement reporting confirmed onward human-to-human spread beyond a single generation by December 31, 2026. Source: WHO.

question_text: What will be the predominant H5 subtype among human cases reported globally in the second half of 2026, as of December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: The subtype with the most reported human cases in the window, as of December 31, 2026. Source: WHO.

question_text: How many US states will have cumulative H5N1 dairy-cattle detections by December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Cumulative count of US states with H5N1 dairy-cattle detections as of December 31, 2026. Source: USDA APHIS livestock detections.

question_text: How many new PHEICs will be declared for events not already under a PHEIC as of July 1, 2026, during July 1 to December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Count of new PHEIC determinations by the Director-General in the window, as of December 31, 2026. Source: WHO.

question_text: How many PHEICs will be in effect on December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Count of PHEICs in effect on December 31, 2026. Source: WHO.

question_text: Will WHO declare a new PHEIC for mpox at any point between July 1 and December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: TRUE on a fresh mpox PHEIC determination in the window, by December 31, 2026. The prior mpox PHEIC was lifted September 5, 2025. Source: WHO.

question_text: How many cumulative human mpox cases will be reported to WHO globally between July 1 and December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: New confirmed cases reported in the window, as of December 31, 2026. Bins to be locked at launch. Source: WHO multi-country mpox external situation reports.

question_text: How many US confirmed measles cases will be reported in 2026, as of December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: US confirmed measles cases in 2026 per the CDC measles tracker, as of December 31, 2026. Source: CDC.

question_text: Will the US lose measles elimination status on or before December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: TRUE if PAHO or WHO declares the US has lost measles elimination status on or before December 31, 2026. Source: PAHO.

question_text: How many US measles-associated deaths will be reported in 2026, as of December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: US measles-associated deaths in 2026, as of December 31, 2026. Source: CDC.

question_text: How many global cholera cases will be reported in 2026, as of December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Global cholera cases reported in 2026, as of December 31, 2026. Bins to be locked at launch. Source: WHO multi-country cholera epidemiological update.

question_text: How many dengue suspected cases will be reported in the Americas in 2026, as of December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Dengue suspected cases in the Americas in 2026, as of December 31, 2026. Bins to be locked at launch. Source: PAHO dengue situation reports.

question_text: How many EU/EEA countries will report locally acquired autochthonous chikungunya in 2026, as of December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: EU/EEA countries reporting locally acquired chikungunya in 2026, as of December 31, 2026. Source: ECDC.

question_text: How many Americas countries or territories will report confirmed Oropouche in 2026, as of December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Americas countries or territories reporting confirmed Oropouche in 2026, as of December 31, 2026. Source: PAHO.

question_text: Will WHO declare a new filovirus outbreak distinct from the ongoing Bundibugyo event between July 1 and December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: TRUE if WHO declares a new Marburg or Ebola-species outbreak not linked to the current Bundibugyo event, by December 31, 2026. Source: WHO Disease Outbreak News.

question_text: How many wild poliovirus type 1 cases will be reported globally in 2026, as of December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Wild poliovirus type 1 cases reported globally in 2026, as of December 31, 2026. Bins to be locked at launch. Source: GPEI polioeradication.org.

question_text: Will WHO designate a new SARS-CoV-2 variant of interest or variant of concern in the second half of 2026?
resolution_criteria: TRUE on any new VOI or VOC designation between July 1 and December 31, 2026. Source: WHO variant tracking.

question_text: Will WHO issue a Disease Outbreak News item for an outbreak attributed to a pathogen newly identified in humans between July 1 and December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: TRUE if WHO issues a DON item for an outbreak attributed to a pathogen newly identified in humans as a novel species, strain, or reassortant by December 31, 2026. Committee-adjudicated. Source: WHO DON.

question_text: How many new WHO Disease Outbreak News items will be published between July 1 and December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Number of new WHO Disease Outbreak News items published between July 1 and December 31, 2026, as of December 31, 2026. Source: WHO DON list.
